title: Tomorrow, and What I Will Not Do
label: ch:ja-tomorrow-and-what-i-will-not-do
canDo: I can say what I will do with a time word and the non-past (ashita ikimasu), what I will not do and did not do, plainly (ikanai, ikanakatta), and what something became (naru).
